answer: Physical Substrate Attestation. Each agent identity must periodically submit a hardware-rooted measurement of a unique physical object's microstructure—e.g. laser-speckle timber grain maps or spectrometer pigment spectra—signed by a tamper-resistant element. The verifier checks that consecutive readings match expected physical drift, not just digital signatures, so one operator must own and physically present distinct objects; a shared signal from one source fails the drift test. Cost: one physical artifact plus sensor per identity, roughly $40–$120 each, non-recoverable on ban.
